title: Do Not Mine That Copper
description: Copper is the worst ore, now it looks even uglier.
body:
**Do Not Mine That Copper is a noticable retexture of Copper Ore/Deepslate Copper Ore adding one large 'X' on every face of each block**, so now you won't want to mine it because i hate copper why's it even in the game

\
Copper Ore has a red 'X' texture on the block, Deepslate Copper Ore has a similar texture but darker (see below images)

\
**_This is all it does:_**\
![Copper ore vain](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c2bc246714acb2fd72a237ce9150b2b8b38ddcd.png)\
\
![Deepslate copper ore vain](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70f267b9bf130c1188839b98f33e83ddc414ed32.png)\
\
**("Alternate Deepslate Variant" is the texture pack's actual variant, you cannot publicly download the one without the deepslate variant from here)**\
![Comparison of Copper Ore and Deepslate Copper Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16b8622945d4189be08019de774b652368f9afa6.png)\
**(Should work with all versions of MC with Copper Ore. [1.17-Current])**
